title: Embedded Trefftz DG method for reaction-diffusion problems on anisotropic meshes
summary: We present and analyze an embedded Trefftz discontinuous Galerkin method for reaction-diffusion problems on anisotropic meshes. The method is constructed by imposing a relaxed local Trefftz condition via an embedding into a tensor-product DG space, yielding a reduced global system while preserving the approximation properties of the underlying high-order discretization. We prove stability and quasi-optimality on anisotropic, possibly curved, quadrilateral elements, and derive anisotropic a priori error estimates.
